summary: Develop practical SME borrower assessment, DSCR, and portfolio risk skills. Explore the five-day course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: SME credit analysis training helps credit analysts, relationship managers, and lending team leads assess borrower risk and repayment capacity. Learners practise spreading financial statements, calculating and interpreting debt service coverage, and documenting risk grades, collateral reviews, and credit recommendations. The course also covers the 5 Cs of Credit, IFRS 9 expected credit loss concepts, and portfolio monitoring, including validation risks in AI-assisted document extraction.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review SME borrowers, recommend credit facilities, approve lending, or monitor business-loan portfolios. It suits intermediate learners with some exposure to credit or lending work.
modules: SME Risk Grades and Digital Analysis
prerequisites: Working familiarity with lending, credit review, or financial statements is recommended. You should be comfortable with basic business arithmetic and financial ratios. Coding is not required; spreadsheet exercises use borrower case information, and advanced AI-assisted document extraction is covered at conceptual-awareness level.
